question: countries top 3 cities json name pop_max
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT c.name AS country, p.name AS city, p.pop_max,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.iso_a3 ORDER BY p.pop_max DESC, p.name) AS rn
  FROM countries c
  JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Within(p.geometry, c.geometry)
)
SELECT country,
       json_group_array(json_object('city', city, 'pop', pop_max) ORDER BY pop_max DESC) AS top_cities
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY country
LIMIT 10;

question: unnest continents list countries city counts
sql:
WITH country_cities AS (
  SELECT c.continent, c.name AS country, count(p.name) AS city_count
  FROM countries c
  LEFT JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Within(p.geometry, c.geometry)
  GROUP BY c.continent, c.name
),
continent_lists AS (
  SELECT continent, list(struct_pack(country := country, cities := city_count) ORDER BY city_count DESC, country) AS country_structs
  FROM country_cities
  GROUP BY continent
)
SELECT continent, s.country, s.cities
FROM continent_lists, UNNEST(country_structs) AS s
ORDER BY continent, s.cities DESC, s.country
LIMIT 20;

question: Brazil top 5 cities distance from Brasilia km
sql:
WITH brazil AS (
  SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE name = 'Brazil'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.name, p.geometry,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY p.pop_max DESC, p.name) AS rn
  FROM brazil b
  JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry)
),
top5 AS (
  SELECT list(struct_pack(name := name, geom := geometry) ORDER BY rn) AS cities
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 5
)
SELECT s.name AS city,
       ST_Distance_Spheroid(s.geom, ST_Point(-47.8825, -15.7942)) / 1000 AS dist_km
FROM top5, UNNEST(cities) AS s
ORDER BY dist_km, s.name;

question: continents >20 countries top 3 economies list
sql:
WITH continent_counts AS (
  SELECT continent, count(*) AS n
  FROM countries
  GROUP BY continent
  HAVING count(*) > 20
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.continent, c.name, c.gdp_md,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.continent ORDER BY c.gdp_md DESC, c.name) AS rn
  FROM countries c
  JOIN continent_counts cc ON c.continent = cc.continent
)
SELECT continent,
       list(name ORDER BY gdp_md DESC) AS top_economies
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
GROUP BY continent
ORDER BY continent;

question: South America unnest cities distance to centroid km
sql:
WITH country_cities AS (
  SELECT c.name AS country, c.geometry AS geom,
         list(struct_pack(city := p.name, geom := p.geometry) ORDER BY p.pop_max DESC) AS cities
  FROM countries c
  JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Within(p.geometry, c.geometry)
  WHERE c.continent = 'South America'
  GROUP BY c.name, c.geometry
)
SELECT country, s.city,
       ST_Distance_Spheroid(s.geom, ST_Centroid(geom)) / 1000 AS dist_km
FROM country_cities, UNNEST(cities) AS s
ORDER BY country, dist_km, s.city
LIMIT 20;
